# Classes generated by chains of actual framed formal comparisons

This internal module constructs `ComparisonClass Φ A` from actual
height-zero framed formal-atlas representatives over the fixed
`Nilp` object `A`, relative to the supplied height-certified frame `Φ`.
It retains the local field, central division algebra, embedded
subfield, residue field and universe hypotheses of
`DrinfeldFramedAtlas`. The target covers may differ and may be
infinite.

`DirectlyComparable X Y` means existence of a specified actual
`Comparison X Y`. Every such step includes actual target
refinements, a formal full-order coordinate isomorphism, equal stored
residue maps and equality of the complete rational framing routes
after the specified quotient reduction.

`ChainEquivalent X Y` is the reflexive transitive closure of these
steps, hence a finite chain. Its symmetry proof reverses each
comparison using its actual inverse and reverses the chain's order.
Concatenation gives transitivity. The setoid and `ComparisonClass`
quotient therefore use only these actual formal comparison steps.
The exact quotient equality criterion is existence of such a chain.

This construction does not assert that every chain collapses to a
single comparison on one common principal refinement. That actual
refinement/composition coherence remains separate. It does not use an
arbitrary equivalence of point functors as a relation. In particular,
the file names its constructed quotient as comparison-chain classes;
identification with an original-source moduli functor remains a
further obligation.

`ChainEquivalent.map_eq` proves by induction that any function
invariant under each actual comparison is invariant along a chain.
`ComparisonClass.lift` uses this proof to descend such functions.
Consequently the actual stored residue map and the existing
height-certified target class descend without choices. Applying the
existing actual quotient-reduction operation gives the descended
reduced target class.

`representative` uses the usual quotient representative choice. It
still belongs to the actual framed type, so retains its own actual
height-certified target, full-order quasi-isogeny and height-zero
condition. Its residue map and target class agree with the descended
data by the quotient representative equation.

The provenance is internal from the actual identity and inverse
comparison constructions and the standard finite-chain relation and
quotient operations. No representing object, universal object,
unconstrained height assignment or point-functor equivalence is
supplied. Direct-comparison transitivity, varying-base functoriality,
group actions, the original-source functor identification and
representability remain open.
